title: Pelican Reckon
style: Australian comedy pop-funk with polka guitar stabs, swing big-band brass, beatbox percussion, harmonica riffs, and a sneaky phonk bass pulse; verse rotates through each family voice, pre-chorus tightens into call-and-response, chorus lands as a chanty group hook. Stacked doubles, playful ad-libs, panned backing shouts, cheeky delay throws, and bright punchy mix with dusty slapback color., comedy, oi, swing, bounce, polka, big band, happy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
West Aussie coast, caravan parked up neat
Coral Coast dream with a salt-baked seat
Corey on the code, upside-down quest
Reverse engineering, I do it best

Mrs Squiggle on the screen, mate, what’s the plan?
Build it forward backward like a mad old man
What’s da pelican reckon? side-eye, stare
Rotto quokka nods like, yeah, I’m there

[Michelle]
Mishy Mish Mash, pickleball queen
I coach that bounce like a smoothie machine
One hand up, two step, clean little slide
Family on the court and the pride don’t hide

[Pre-Chorus]
[All]
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie (aha, aha)
Here we go, here we go (ha ha ha)
Wez in the game, Roo in the frame
Micha in the breeze and we all say the name

[Chorus]
Pelican reckon, yeah, pelican reckon
What’s da pelican reckon? we all second-guess it
Pelican reckon, yeah, pelican reckon
Coral Coast living and the caravan bless it

Ruby roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Ruby roo roo roo, make the sand all bounce
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie
Oi oi oi, we shout it out loud

[Verse 2]
[Ruby]
My art stays with me, glued in my hand
Brush on the page and the paper stands
Ruby, Roo Roo, I tag my line
Pink and grey galah with a glittery shine

I draw the sun on the van side door
Turn a little shell into a whole world more
Bo bo, aye i i, that’s my sound
Kanga bounce giggle when I spin around

[Wez]
Wez the gamer pro, coach on the mic
Fast with the thumbs and the banter’s tight
Hola, mate, I’m coming in hot
Goal in my head and I’ve already got

Sneaky panther mode, prowlin’ local style
Beatbox kicks while I run that mile
Two dogs, lots of frogs, what a mad little scene
And one black sniffer poodle, all clean and mean

[Bridge]
[Corey]
Asher Ashley, where’s Micha gone?
[Michelle]
Off she goes, super dog speed, gone!
[Ruby]
My art stays with me
[Wez]
And weza, weza, that’s the code I run

[All]
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie (aha, aha)
Here we go, here we go (ha ha ha)
What’s da pelican reckon? tell me now
We’ll laugh that answer out somehow

[Final Chorus]
Pelican reckon, yeah, pelican reckon
What’s da pelican reckon? we all second-guess it
Pelican reckon, yeah, pelican reckon
West coast holiday and the caravan bless it

Ruby roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Ruby roo roo roo, make the sand all bounce
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie
Oi oi oi, we shout it out loud

[Outro]
Micha, Micha, on the move
Wez and Roo and Corey too
Mishy Mish Mash, coach in flight
Never ending holiday tonight
